question: The marked price of a school bag was Rs. 550. This price was 10% above the cost price. It was sold at a discount of 10% on the marked price. Find the gain or loss percentage.
solution:
Given:

MP of a school bag = Rs. 550

MP = CP + CP × 10/100

Discount on MP = 10%

Formula used:

Loss % = ((CP - SP) / CP ) × 100

Calculations:

⇒ 550 = (100 + 10)/100 × CP

⇒ CP = 550 × 100 / 110 = Rs. 500

According to the given data,

⇒ SP = MP × ((100 - 10))/(100)

⇒ SP = 550 × (90)/(100) = Rs. 495

Now, Loss% = (500 - 495)/500 × 100

⇒ Loss% = 5/500 × 100 = 1

**∴ The loss percentage is 1%.**
